A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present the first study on the automatic construction of two commonsense knowledge bases, ATOMIC and ConceptNet.
commonsense knowledge graphs can be automatically completed by generative language models that learn from implicit knowledge in pre trained language models.

we propose COMET: a novel commonsense knowledge generation model, and demonstrate its ability to generate novel knowledge with high precision, and to complete commonsense knowledge graphs with high quality.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the development of generati ve models of commonsense can be an important first step toward the automatic construction of commonsense knowledge graphs.
deep pre-trained language models can be leveraged to generate high quality and novel commonsense knowledge, which can be used for commonsense KB completion.
